coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first. A targeted CMS-domain search did not surface a newer qualifying notice, but the CMS Public Notices page itself was not retrievable through the available web fetch, so the official-notice leg is partially degraded. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were completed across hospital/ED/maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance/air-medical, CLIA/provider-action risk, restoration/reopening, and U.S. territories. No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access change was identified in the bounded window. September 28 maternity-access coverage in Minnesota and Maine described previously established closures or decisions rather than a newly effective in-window access change. Non-U.S., proposal-only, ownership-only, historical, unsupported, and duplicate items were excluded.
